name: Carrot Sticks with Green Goddess Yogurt Dip
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Add yogurt, oil, capers, and spices to the blender. Blend on high until smooth, adding water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks.
To serve, divide carrots and dip between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
